description:
Bind the exact bytes of a .lazy file to an unsigned release manifest for a trusted edge
        supervisor at the site. Signing, staging, approval and running happen on that supervisor,
        never through this server.
        Example: prepare_edge_release_manifest(graph_file=<create_graph(..., include_file=true).graph_file>, site_id="plant-milan", release_id="line1-r7").

graph_file.description: The .lazy file content as a JSON object, exactly as create_graph returned it.
graph_file.title: Graph File

include_exact_json.description: Also return the canonical JSON bytes the manifest hashes.
include_exact_json.title: Include Exact Json

release_id.description: Your identifier for this release, e.g. line1-r7.
release_id.title: Release Id

site_id.description: The site the release is for, e.g. plant-milan.
site_id.title: Site Id

name: prepare_edge_release_manifest
title: Prepare an edge release manifest
